# sha256 of the uv release tarballs .github/ci/install-uv.sh accepts: <version> <target> <sha256>.
# Each value is the release's own <tarball>.sha256 (github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases), checked against a hash of the
# downloaded tarball. A new OKF_LINUX_UV needs its two lines here (tools/ci-workflow.test.sh fails without them).
